name: PLATO Sparse SDP Benchmark
description: Evaluates SDP solvers on 75 sparse and structured semidefinite programming problems drawn from the SDP repository, QAP problems, DIMACS instances, and the PENNON collection. Both CPU and GPU implementations are compared, including cuLoRADS for GPU-accelerated first-order SDP solving. Performance is measured using the DIMACS error standards for solution quality.
typical_sota_score: COPT best (scaled mean 1.0); cuLoRADS (GPU) solved 71/75; SeDuMi had highest failure rate. 40,000-second time limit.
reputation: Current and regularly updated SDP solver benchmark; authoritative reference maintained by Hans Mittelmann.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. GPU hardware: Intel Xeon + H100. Hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X (12 cores, 128GB). Includes GPU vs CPU comparison.
